notes.1746: Concluding sentence plus the lead-in 'འདིར་བཤད་པ།', which closes the paragraph before the summary verses (rule 5).
notes.1760: Closing stanza in long metre: beings lack the power to realize it (oil-drop simile), therefore the author compiled this lamp; one four-line stanza.
notes.1764: Chapter-closing line '…ལེའུ་བཅུ་གཅིག་པའོ།' is a rubric and stands alone.
